Name: Item AutoTrasher
Author: S1mmyy
Description:
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][color=#ffff00][size=3][i][center]﻿[i]Have you ever gone spelunking in the mines and been annoyed by any of the items that have little value, like sap, or slime?
[/i][/center]
[center][i]Do you wish you didn't have to manually delete them every time so that more important items can be stored?[/i][/center][/i][/size][/color][/font]
[center][u][font=Tahoma][color=#ff7700][size=6][b]Then this mod is for you!!![/b][/size][/color][/font][/u][/center]

[size=5][u]Install[/u][/size]
[size=3][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][/size]

[size=5][u]How to use[/u][/size]
[list][size=3]In the configuration file provided [b](config file doesn't exist initially, is generated after game launch)[/b], you can add the numerical IDs of items that you want to be deleted, can toggle whether you want the feature to work only while in the mines or anywhere, and can change the key to toggle the feature on and off.[/size][/list]

Downloads.Description: Update for compatibility with Stardew Valley 1.6

Manifest.Name: AutoTrash
Manifest.Description: Trashes items specified by the player when they're picked up.
